description: This Python source file implements an AWS Secrets Manager integration, providing asynchronous and synchronous methods for reading, writing, and deleting secrets. It extends base classes for common secret management and AWS-specific functionality, handles environment validation, constructs and signs requests, and manages AWS credentials.
